# `silk/http_basic`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Explicit bounded HTTP Basic authorization from caller-encoded credential bytes.

## Details

The caller chooses the character encoding and supplies scratch and output buffers.
Encoding validates both credentials and both capacities before it changes either buffer.
The HTTP client controls origin binding and permission to send credentials over plain HTTP.

Import as `HttpBasic` with `import silk.http_basic as HttpBasic`.

## `encodeInto`

```silk
pub fn encodeInto(username: &[u8], password: &[u8], scratch: &mut [u8], output: &mut [u8]) -> Result<
  usize,
  BasicError,
>
```

Writes `Basic ` and padded Base64 of `username:password`, returning the complete byte count.

### Details

A colon in the username or a control byte or DEL in either credential fails before mutation.
Non-ASCII bytes are accepted without character conversion. Failure leaves output and scratch unchanged.
Scratch retains the combined credential after success; the caller controls its later use and erasure.
